mapper.select: -- file name: MyDashboardMapper.xml -- query id: getHospitalInfo select a.hospital_id , coalesce(min(a.hospital_nm), a.hospital_id::text) as institution_name , 'HOSPITAL' as institution_type , min(a.sub_dvsn_nm) as city_name , min(a.nat_cd) as nation_code , min(a.nat_nm) as nation_name , min(a.nat_area_cd) as area_code , null::timestamptz as registration_date , null::timestamptz as expiration_date , '' as contact_email , case when exists ( select 1 from gmcs_main_daily b where b.hospital_id = a.hospital_id ) then 'LIS' else 'HL7' end as data_type from mv_hospital_region as a where a.hospital_id = #{hospitalId}::uuid group by a.hospital_id ;

-- file name: MyDashboardMapper.xml -- query id: getClabInfo select a.clab_id , case when count(c.hospital_id) > 0 then string_agg(distinct d.hospital_nm, ' / ' order by d.hospital_nm) else min(a.clab_nm) end as institution_name , case when count(c.hospital_id) > 0 then 'AFFILIATED' else 'CLAB' end as institution_type , min(a.sub_dvsn_nm) as city_name , min(a.nat_cd) as nation_code , min(a.nat_nm) as nation_name , min(a.nat_area_cd) as area_code , min(b.provide_start_dt) as registration_date , max(b.provide_end_dt) as contract_expiration_date , min(a.contact_email) as contact_email , case when exists ( select 1 from gmcs_main_daily b where b.clab_id = a.clab_id ) then 'LIS' else 'HL7' end as data_type from mv_clab_region as a left outer join mv_gmcs_clab_contract as b on a.clab_id = b.clab_id and current_date between b.provide_start_dt and b.provide_end_dt left outer join mv_clab_affiliated_hospital as c on c.clab_id = a.clab_id and c.hospital_id is not null left outer join mv_hospital_region as d on d.hospital_id = c.hospital_id where a.clab_id = #{clabId} group by a.clab_id ;
